units.source_text: 源氏公子怀着心事，吩咐随从者早早就寝。

en.t: Prince Genji, troubled by his thoughts, ordered his attendants to go to bed early.

units.source_text: 空蝉处派小君去通消息，但小君找她不着。

en.t: From Utsusemi's quarters, Kogimi was sent to carry a message, but he could not find her.

units.source_text: 他到处都找遍，走进廊下的房间，好容易才找到。

en.t: He searched everywhere, then went into a room off the corridor and finally managed to find her.

units.source_text: 他觉得姐姐太过无情，哭丧着脸说：

en.t: Thinking his sister far too heartless, he said with a tearful face:

units.source_text: “人家会说我太无能了！”

en.t: "People will say I am completely useless!"

units.source_text: 姐姐骂道：

en.t: His sister scolded him:

units.source_text: “你怎么干这无聊的事？

en.t: "Why are you doing such a foolish thing?

units.source_text: 孩子们当这种差使，最是可恶！”

en.t: It is most hateful when children take on errands like this!"

units.source_text: 又断然地说：

en.t: Then she said firmly:

units.source_text: “你去对他说：

en.t: "Go and tell him this:

units.source_text: 我今晚身上不好，要众侍女都在身边，好服侍我。

en.t: I am unwell tonight, and I need all my waiting women beside me to attend to me.

units.source_text: 你这样赶来赶去，教人见了怀疑！”

en.t: If you keep rushing back and forth like this, people will see you and grow suspicious!"

units.source_text: 但她心中这样想：

en.t: But in her heart she thought:

units.source_text: “如果我身没有出嫁，住在父母之家的深闺里，

en.t: "If I had not married, and were living secluded deep within my parents' house,

units.source_text: 偶尔等待公子来访，那才是风流韵事。

en.t: then waiting now and then for the prince to visit would truly be a romantic affair.

units.source_text: 但是现在……

en.t: But now...

units.source_text: 我勉强装作无情，坚决拒绝，

en.t: I force myself to seem heartless and refuse him firmly,

units.source_text: 不知公子当我是何等不识风趣的人？”

en.t: and I wonder how utterly lacking in feeling the prince must think I am."

units.source_text: 想到这里，真心地感伤起来，方寸缭乱了。

en.t: Thinking this, she became genuinely sorrowful, and her heart was thrown into confusion.

units.source_text: 但她终于下个决心：

en.t: But at last she made up her mind:

units.source_text: “无论怎样，现在我已经是毫不足道的薄命人了，

en.t: "In any case, I am already an insignificant, ill-fated woman now,

units.source_text: 我就做个不识风趣的愚妇吧！”

en.t: so I may as well become a foolish woman who knows nothing of romance!"
